easyPrerequisites: Phantom Steed must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Fiend Hunter must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Fiend Hunter for its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
